RELITE CF/CR is a gel type strongly acidic 
 cation exchange resin characterized by a high DVB content.

This resin is supplied in a calibrated screen grade and in regenerated form 
 (H+) to permit the direct use in counter-current systems. Its 
 composition complies with the existing food processing rules and regulation.

Operating capacity depends on various 
 parameters, such as Na ratio, Na leakage endpoint, kinetic load and 
 regenerate level.

Warning: Being this resin supplied in H+ form, care must be 
taken during its
handling

RELITE 2AS/CR is a " TYPE 11" porous 
 type strongly basic anion exchange resin.

This resin is supplied in a calibrated screen 
 grade to permit the use in counter-current systems.Its composition complies 
 with the existing food processing rules and regulations.
Operating capacity depends on various parameters, such as inlet composition, endpoin, kinetic load and regenerate level.
Mixed Beds Cation Resin Type RELITE CF / MB

RELITE CF/MB is a gel type strongly acidic cation exchange resin 
 characterized by a high DVB content.

This resin is supplied in a calibrated screen 
 grade and in regenerated form ( H+)to permit the direct use in standard 
 mixed beds. Its composition complies with the existing food processing rules 
 and regulations.

Operating capacity depends on various parameters, such as Na ratio, Na 
 leakage endpoint, kinetic load and regenerate level.

Warning: Being this resin supplied in H+ form, care must be 
taken during its handling
Mixed Beds Anion Resin Type RELITE 3AS / MB

RELITE 3AS/MB is a " TYPE 1" porous type strongly basic anion exchange 
 Resin.

This resin is supplied in a calibrated screen 
 grade to permit the use in two components mixed bed filters. Its composition 
 complies with the existing food processing rules and regulations.

Operating capacity depends on various 
 parameters , such as inlet composition , endpoint , kinetic load and 
 regenerate level .

Introduction
The proposed 
 demineralization plant consists of two indentical trains, to supply 
 demineralized water to power station.
Each train 
 mainly consists of the followings:
one cationic vessel 
 capacity 700 liter.
one 
 anionic vessel capacity 750 liter.
one mixed 
 bed vessel capacity 250 liter cationic resin and 300 liter of 
 anionic resin.
